speaker: diane_sterling
headline: A PROJECT PIPELINE MUST CONVERT, NOT ACCUMULATE.
deck: A large portfolio looks impressive until projects are tested for readiness, procurement, execution and actual service entry.
quote: Count projects by conversion stage, not by the number of announcements.
facts: Pipeline visibility exposes where projects repeatedly stall.
Readiness should precede procurement rather than follow it.
Delivery risk rises when too many projects enter execution unprepared.
Completion only matters when an asset enters productive use.
takeaway: A credible portfolio is a conversion engine from prepared capital to functioning assets, not a warehouse of promises.
